PB15-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Or, draw two cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)

PB15-01.name: The AntKing Ant-Res
PB15-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] was used to pay the cost, also, put three cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can send the [Soul Core] from your Reserve to your Trash. When you've done so, exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, refresh this Spirit.

PX14-032.effect:

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]

[utb]
